question: Omuhereza w’abaana abato omu kukora omulimo gw’okwegyesa, omu mutima gw’enkolagana y’obwengye n’okubara, akora omugani ogurikukurira abaana: omu tubinja tukye, abagambira kutwara emigogo ebiri ya pulasitiki eine obwingana bumwe, kukora omupiira murungi ogumu n’emiipiira mito n’ogundi. Bwanyima, ababuza abaana: "Murihenda hariho pulasitiki nyingi aha?" Twaba nitureeba embeera eyo, obwengye ki obw’okubara oburikukuzibwa n’omulimo ogu?

Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa mukaga nagyerize omutwe gw'ebicweka bisatu kandi yashushaniize omurimo ahu abegi barikugambwa kwombeka ebicweka bisatu bina ebirikugira obureingwa bw'enkingi: Ekicweka kisatu 1: 12 cm, 5 cm na 11 cm. Ekicweka kisatu 2: 12 cm, 5 cm na 9 cm. Ekicweka kisatu 3: 12 cm, 5 cm na 7 cm. Ekicweka kisatu 4: 12 cm, 5 cm na 5 cm. Hanyuma, nibagambwa kureeba ebi bombekire no kubigeraanisa na bagenzi baabo kwemeza ngu boona bareeba ekintu kimwe. Nigiki ekigyendererwa ekikuru ky'okwega omu murimo ogurikugambwaho ahaiguru?
answer_a: Geranisiza enshatu nk'okuhingurukana oburaingwa bw'embaju zaazo n'emyanya yaazo.
answer_b: Teebwa ebiteebwa ebiragira embeera ezirikwetagisa omuhanda gw'okubaka enshatu
answer_c: Gamba eby’okurabura ebikwata aha mukago oguri hagati y’embaju n’engyesa z’enyanga eshatu.
answer_d: Taaya eshatu omuhanda gw'okugyeragyeranisa obureingwa bw'embaju zaazo orikurugiirira aha migyeraniso.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omwaka ogwa kabiri omuishaaya ya haiguru akahwa omutwe gw'enamba ez'amazima n'abegyeswa be kandi nayenda kucereebeza oba nibashobora kukora ebizibu ebitaina eby'okugarukamu omu kibina ky'enamba ezirimu omugabo. Ni murimo ki ogw'okucereebeza oguraagwisa omwegyesa kutunga amakuru ahari eki?
answer_a: Manya obuhingiro bw'empimo y'ahaiguru y'empindahantu eshatu ey'omuburinganiza erikugira enkingi 2.
answer_b: Bariindiza namba ezitarikukora kuruga ahansi n'ahaiguru
answer_c: Shanga emizi y'omuzaho enyanjura aha mukura gw'omubaro, orondooze orikukoresibwa
answer_d: Sharamura obureezi bw'amaguru g'empindahantu eshatu ey'omuringaniza engondi erikuruherera eripima 2/sqrt(2)
